name: Counted textarea
summary: The multi-line settings field — a CountedInput that wraps to several lines, grows from minRows to maxRows then scrolls, with the same focus-only character counter.
lead: ONE custom element — <aha-counted-textarea> — the multi-line sibling of CountedInput for descriptions and long answers. It autogrows from `minrows` to `maxrows` and then scrolls internally rather than growing unbounded (SETTINGS-21). Its character counter is REVEALED ONLY ON FOCUS and hidden at rest (SETTINGS-42): a persistent overlay pinned to the field's bottom-right — never a sibling beside the field — with the bottom padding always reserved so revealing it never shifts the text. Focus toggles an attribute on a persistent node, so the opacity transition actually fires. Shadow-DOM CSS, themed only by --aha-* tokens; emits composed `input` / `change`. Zero drift — the same element in React and Vue.
codeNote: Same element, same shadow-DOM CSS → identical render. React (< 19) consumes it via a thin ref wrapper; Vue binds the custom element natively. Defined once in @ahaslides-product/design.

spec.label: Autogrow
spec.value: minrows (default 2) → maxrows (default 4); beyond maxrows scrolls internally, never grows unbounded

spec.label: Counter
spec.value: 12/18 #8A8A8A, overlay bottom-right; opacity 0 at rest → 1 on focus

spec.label: Reveal
spec.value: focus-only (:host([_focused][_counted])) — hidden at rest; space always reserved (no shift)

props.name: maxlength
props.desc: Character cap; presence turns the focus-only counter on (shows current/max)

props.name: minrows
props.desc: Rows shown at rest — the field never shrinks below this

props.name: maxrows
props.desc: Rows the field grows to before it scrolls internally instead of growing

props.name: status
props.desc: Error recolours the border + ring and sets aria-invalid

props.name: readonly
props.desc: Selectable but not editable; secondary fill

props.name: borderless
props.desc: Drop the field's own border/ring/fill — for composing inside a parent that carries the one border (OptionRow, SETTINGS-34)

props.name: input
props.desc: Composed event on each keystroke; read e.detail.value

whenToUse.when: a multi-line settings field — a description, a long answer — that needs a character cap; the counter appears only on focus
the single-line sibling — option/answer/label text with a cap
a general single-line field with no counter (names, search)

opinion.note: Never show a permanent counter on every field — it reads as heavy. The counter belongs inside the field, revealed on focus. Cap the growth: a textarea that grows without bound pushes the rest of the panel down; grow to maxRows then scroll.
opinion.dsv3: COVERED — the settings-lab CountedTextarea control mapped into the DS. Box, border, focus ring and error status reuse the DS V3 field family; the autogrow-then-scroll behaviour and the focus-only bottom-right counter are the settings-specific additions (SETTINGS-21/42).

snippets.label: HTML
snippets.note: The native form — a web component in an HTML file renders on open, no build step.

selfCheck.label: grows minrows→maxrows then scrolls internally (never unbounded)
counter hidden at rest, revealed on focus (opacity), overlay bottom-right
counter space reserved — revealing it does not shift the text
